newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three differentials ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three differentials ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel differentials eased in Group Three and were steady in Chicago on Friday, traders said.
Basis moved lower across the board, tracking a 0.57 cent a gallon drop in front-month heating oil and 0.87 cent a gallon decline in front-month unleaded NYMEX futures.

Downward pressure on Midwest spot products prices was expected to continue into next week on continued wholesaler discounting and a two million barrel batch of unleaded gasoline scheduled by Williams to arrive in late September, traders said.
"I would imagine we should see some additional selling in the gas next week," one Group trader said.
Group Three unleaded gasoline eased to bids 1.0 cent a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 1.25 cent under for later deliveries, with premium steady at 2.50 cents higher.
Chicago unleaded gasoline differentials were steady at 1.50/1.25 cents under the print for prompt and later deliveries, and premium was talked 2.75 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur diesel eased modestly to bids 1.50 cents over the print for prompt and later deliveries, with high sulphur talked 0.25 cent a gallon under.
Chicago low sulphur diesel remained 0.75/1.0 cent a gallon over the print, and high sulphur was 0.50 cent under the print.
Jet/kero was talked 2.75/3.0 cents over the print in Group Three and 3.0/3.25 cents over in Chicago.
